name: site-harness
allowedSites: Any registered HTTPS website and its explicitly registered API/asset hosts
claims: Exact host-issued capability and site resource per validated invocation
credentials: Environment for official APIs; manually created private local browser session
graphql: AST-validated queries; unknown persisted operations need an explicitly declared read path
discovery: Observe page requests, including generic POSTs, with action endpoint and origin guards
replay: GET/HEAD and declared POST read paths; no write operations
